tool.source_policy: Exact clean intended commit; current pin also uses the shared consumer API's exact source digest. Development overrides must explicitly supply the intended revision.

execution_supervision.mode: Consumer TCP route watchdog with official shared verify/build bindings before and after

native_milestone.scope: All eligible identities from the complete observed assisted route; entire temporary-code spans remain interpreted. Unvisited overlays and full game/campaign/native completion are unqualified.

build.PCE_MODULE_SOURCE: Private generated module supplied explicitly; empty means interpreter-only sandbox.

qualified_private_route.loader: Upstream explicit BIOS-backed contiguous payload loader; not an authentic machine-reset claim.
qualified_private_route.cd_unknown_status_limit: Explicit reference-emulator GOOD-response compatibility profile; unknown operations remain unimplemented and hardware behavior is unqualified.
qualified_private_route.bram: Read-only initial seed; guest writes are volatile and process-local; cross-process save persistence is unimplemented.
qualified_private_route.progression: Assisted boss encounter is separate from ordinary-input qualification and campaign completion.

previous_native_milestone.scope: Bounded assisted route; hot original-code subset from a separate complete observed profile. Cold and unseen code remain interpreted; not full native or campaign qualification.
